subject: Marketplace integration roadmap and listing timeline - AvaCloud
messages:
From: AvaCloud Partnerships <partners@avacloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor OBrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: lina.park@avacloud.com
Date: Mon, 02 Jun 2025 14:12:00 +0000
Subject: Marketplace listing & integration requirements - AvaCloud x Redwood

Hi Marissa & Connor,

Thanks again for the demo last week — we liked the latency profile for your hosted offering. AvaCloud is preparing a dedicated partner listing on our marketplace and we need to confirm a few items from Redwood before we can proceed to the technical validation step. Attached is our marketplace requirements pack (ava_marketplace_requirements.pdf). The key asks:

- SOC 2 / security attestation (cert or letter)
- Billing integration (invoice-level metadata + marketplace fee split)
- A small connector for provisioning consumption-based SKUs (API + webhook flow)
- Expected go-live window (we aim for a soft launch June 30)

Can you confirm who on your side will own each of these items and whether any exceptions are required for Private deployments? Lina (cc) is the PM on the listing project.

Appreciate a short reply with owners and a high-level timeline.

Best,
AvaCloud Partnerships
partners@avacloud.com

Attachment: ava_marketplace_requirements.pdf (PDF, 270KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: AvaCloud Partnerships <partners@avacloud.com>
Cc: Connor OBrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Jun 2025 09:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing & integration requirements - AvaCloud x Redwood

Hi Lina / AvaCloud team — thanks for the doc. Quick owners and notes below:

- SOC 2 attestation: Hiro Tanaka (security) — can provide certification and evidence (we host SOC 2 Type II for our service).
- Billing integration: Connor OBrien (engineering Partnerships) — will scope the invoice metadata + marketplace fee flow; need to confirm supported fields from your side.
- Provisioning connector (API + webhooks): Tessa Morgan (product infra) + Eng — will produce a small connector and test harness.
- Private deployments: Vivek Kulkarni (sales/solutions) — will confirm contractual exceptions (some enterprise customers require different billing flows).

I've attached a brief internal checklist to speed triage (redwood_marketplace_checklist.xlsx). Can you confirm the exact webhook payload spec and whether you require DocuSign-ready SOW language?

Proposed next step: 30-minute technical kickoff this week. We can do Thu 6/5 or Mon 6/9 — let me know which works.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor OBrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: AvaCloud Partnerships <partners@avacloud.com>, lina.park@avacloud.com
Date: Wed, 04 Jun 2025 11:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing & integration requirements - AvaCloud x Redwood

Marissa / team — I reviewed the requirements and sketched the integration impact. High-level notes:

- SOC 2: our attestation covers hosted & dedicated but Private/on-prem customers require a slightly different control mapping; if the listing must call out private deployment guarantees we should include an exception clause.
- Billing metadata: we support customer_id, subscription_id, usage_units, and per-token units. If Ava needs line-item marketplace fees we can include marketplace_fee_percent and marketplace_external_id in invoice metadata.
- Provisioning connector: plan below — ETA 3 weeks (2-week dev + 1-week integration + test harness). Can do a canary flow for 2-3 customers.

Proposed exceptions/asks from product:
- If marketplace requires attribution at token-level we need to add a short flag in the runtime (minor perf impact) — decision needed.
- For DocuSign SOW: legal will need a minimal commercial template; can we get a sample SOW from Ava to speed review?

I attached a short technical notes file (integration_impact_notes.md).

—Tessa
Senior Product Manager, Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwood.com

Attachment: integration_impact_notes.md (text, 5KB)

From: Lina Park <lina.park@avacloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor OBrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Jun 2025 16:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing & integration requirements - AvaCloud x Redwood

Thanks Marissa/Tessa — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side:

- Webhook payload: we send an initial provisioning POST with sku_id, buyer_account_id, start_date, and optionally external_reference. We can share the OpenAPI spec — linking here: https://confluence.avacloud.com/display/PM/Marketplace+Listing+Process
- SOC 2: our compliance team will accept a signed attestation and the control map; we don't require in-person audits.
- Timeline: our target remains June 30 for soft launch; to make that we need a technical checkpoint by 6/17 and a signed SOW by 6/20.

Attached is a sample SOW language (SOW_v0.2.docx). We also need a point of contact for legal to exchange contract redlines.

Can Redwood commit to the technical checkpoint on 6/17? If yes, we'll schedule a validation slot with our marketplace QA team.

Best,
Lina Park
Product Manager, AvaCloud Marketplace
lina.park@avacloud.com

Attachment: SOW_v0.2.docx (Word, 18KB)
